modules.name: Converter
modules.description: Independent calibrated ADC/DAC paths with selectable voltage ranges and clock policies.

modules.name: Clocked Register
modules.description: One byte of clocked state: selectable clock source, reset word, explicit seed publication, and polyphonic byte-bus input/output.

modules.name: Lookup
modules.description: Original generated harmonic, formant, fold, CV, Walsh, rhythm, envelope, step-sequence, nested-density and ratio-grid transforms, with numeric morphing, JUMP shape steps from a bus bit, explicit ramp tracking and custom Vastish table import.

modules.name: Counter
modules.description: An 8-bit word that counts: increment from a knob or a byte bus, modulus 2-256, Loop, One-shot or Pendulum, seed, carry, and the Clocked Register's clock rules.

modules.name: Switch
modules.description: Two byte words in, one out, under a control word: select A or B by a bit, take each bit from A or B, or crossfade; follows A's clock or reclocks on its own.

modules.name: Pipeline
modules.description: A byte delay line of 1-64 edges with a per-bit spread and a loop that repeats the last DELAY words; the Clocked Register's clock rules.

modules.name: Lookup2
modules.description: Two byte words in, one out: all sixteen bit-logic functions, byte arithmetic with mix and ring, a two-input fold and two-word Walsh maps, on A's clock, with JUMP shape steps.

modules.name: Counter 2
modules.description: A phase word at N/D of its clock (N 1-16, D 1-64, or a ratio word on RATIO), exact for ever, with carry on each cycle: polymeter and cross rhythms locked to a clock.

modules.name: Fan
modules.description: A 5-bit address routes one signal to 32 outputs and one of 32 inputs to a common output, on 16-channel cables: an up/down counter of 1-32 steps or a byte bus, with an optional late-enable glitch.

modules.name: Lattice
modules.description: A 4 x 4 step sequencer on two up/down counters with separate clocks, cross-coupled jumps after the Nonlinearcircuits Bindubba, two slewed outputs, and its state on a byte bus.
